advSearch.title: Ask Claude to search the library
advSearch.intro: Describe what you are looking for in your own words. Claude runs a few keyword searches of the documents in the folders enabled for the AI, reads pages only when needed, and answers with the most relevant documents. The normal search is not changed.
advSearch.placeholder: For example: papers comparing efficient attention methods for long documents
advSearch.needText: Write your request to see the estimate.
advSearch.estimateNote: Approximate: it covers your request and the instructions. The pages Claude reads add to it. No document is sent with the request itself.
advSearch.sentTo: Your request goes to the model {{model}}.
advSearch.folders: While searching, Claude may read documents in these folders:
advSearch.fix_no-folders: Enable at least one folder for the AI in the library settings. The normal search works as usual.
